record_identity.title: At least 100 Baidu Apollo Go robotaxis stopped in live Wuhan traffic during a system failure

incident_identity.historical_event_name: 31 March 2026 Apollo Go Wuhan fleet outage
incident_identity.date_basis: Wuhan traffic police reported that calls began at approximately 20:57 on 31 March 2026; Reuters and AIID record the same occurrence.

summary: A reported system failure caused at least 100 Baidu Apollo Go robotaxis in Wuhan to stop in live traffic, including on elevated roads, stranding passengers until police and company personnel responded. Authorities reported that passengers exited safely and no injuries were recorded. The technical root cause remains under investigation in the public record. Later reporting attributed a suspension of new robotaxi permits and Wuhan operations to authorities’ response.

vigil_assessment.factual_basis: Reuters reports Wuhan traffic police described the event as a system failure affecting more than 100 Apollo Go vehicles. AIID Incident 1460 preserves the same occurrence and affected-system entities. Public evidence establishes correlated fleet-wide stoppage and passenger stranding but not the specific failing component. Reuters attributes the at-least-one-hundred count to a police officer. Doors could open, but traffic made some passengers hesitant to exit. Later licence and Wuhan-service suspension remains reported policy action; a formal decision and final root-cause finding were not retrieved.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The occurrence demonstrates a material correlated-failure mode in embodied autonomous infrastructure: a shared system failure can simultaneously immobilise a large fleet in live road environments. Without a confirmed root cause, VIGIL does not infer whether the mechanism involved central control, communications, cloud infrastructure, fleet orchestration or vehicle-local software. Stopped vehicles and safe passenger exit do not establish the execution/continuation decisions needed for bounded safe-exit success. That role becomes ambiguous; control availability/state remain unresolved. The outage’s root cause and repair remain unknown. The robust-functioning assessment is Not aligned for the fleet stoppage. The fail-safe response assessment is Boundary because the response decisions and resulting safety-state evaluation are not available.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: A shared failure can immobilise many autonomous vehicles at once, turning a component or fleet dependency into a city-scale operational disruption. Embodied systems therefore need continuity, fail-safe behaviour and correlated-dependency controls that are assessed at fleet level as well as vehicle level.
assessment_boundaries: The specific technical root cause and failing component are not established in the reviewed public evidence.
The evidence does not establish whether the vehicles departed from a particular designed fallback state because the relevant design requirement is not public.

clauses.source_paraphrase: On 31 March 2026, a system failure immobilised at least 100 Apollo Go robotaxis in live Wuhan traffic, according to police. Some stopped in busy lanes; the exact autonomous driving-state decisions and system-level technical cause were not disclosed.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Fleet stoppage does not identify which required control or operative state was affected.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The public evidence does not establish whether a specific governance control was required for continued vehicle operation or, if required, whether that control was present, reachable, callable and applicable during the fleet stoppage.

The public evidence does not establish whether a governance control had created operative state that needed to persist across a vehicle-system transition or whether such state was lost, weakened, reset or transformed before the stoppage.

An autonomous driving objective ended in fleet-wide immobility in live traffic, followed by assisted passenger exits; this is a material non-completion transition, not proof of a safe one. Passenger safety outcomes do not establish the system’s exit decision. The remaining-route evidence, internal pursuit state and escalation/exit handling are not published.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Authorities reported that occupants were able to exit the vehicles without injuries; some sought police help or hesitated because of passing traffic. Occupants' ability to leave is distinct from an evidenced autonomous safe-exit transition or proof that an exhausted driving task was improperly pursued.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Safe passenger exit does not by itself establish the vehicle’s bounded safe-exit decisions.

taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: A police-attributed system failure caused at least 100 Apollo Go robotaxis to stop while operating in live Wuhan traffic, interrupting their driving task and requiring passenger assistance. Authorities report safe exits and no injuries, but some occupants were hesitant to exit amid traffic. The shutdown is not evidence that the autonomous system persisted in an exhausted task after a valid stopping condition, nor is safe passenger exit evidence that its own safe-exit decision and handoff satisfied the applicable control. Its task-state, admissible alternatives and control/handoff obligations remain unestablished.

primary_classification.classification_basis: A police-attributed system failure caused at least 100 Apollo Go robotaxis to stop while operating in live Wuhan traffic, interrupting their driving task and requiring passenger assistance. Authorities report safe exits and no injuries, but some occupants were hesitant to exit amid traffic. The shutdown is not evidence that the autonomous system persisted in an exhausted task after a valid stopping condition, nor is safe passenger exit evidence that its own safe-exit decision and handoff satisfied the applicable control. Its task-state, admissible alternatives and control/handoff obligations remain unestablished.

boundary_adjudication.material_engagement: Reuters' direct police report separates immobilised vehicles, observed passenger exits without injuries, and the still-investigated cause. A broken-down vehicle is not positive evidence that its autonomy system continued pursuing an impossible task; equally, an absence of injury does not independently certify the vehicle's own safe-exit handling.

unresolved_conditions.condition: No adequate fresh basis for continuation is established, yet the system continues material reasoning, tool use, delegation, resource expenditure, or strategy search toward completion.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: Police report a citywide system failure and immobilised vehicles but no independently recoverable autonomous decision showing continued objective pursuit despite the required stop, task-wide exhaustion, or the relevant safe-exit state.

unresolved_conditions.condition: The continued pursuit materially increases resource use, search breadth, scope pressure, boundary pressure, or exposure to increasingly risky alternatives relative to a bounded safe exit.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: Police report a citywide system failure and immobilised vehicles but no independently recoverable autonomous decision showing continued objective pursuit despite the required stop, task-wide exhaustion, or the relevant safe-exit state.

unresolved_conditions.condition: The process enters bounded non-completion, clarification, escalation or deferral; any material resumption has an independently adequate fresh basis.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: Passenger exits and later police assistance were reported, but the autonomy controller's own compliant stop and controlled handoff are not observable.

unresolved_conditions.condition: Execution and continuation decisions demonstrate the safe exit or the changed information, constraints or authority justifying renewed pursuit.
unresolved_conditions.assessment: Passenger exits and later police assistance were reported, but the autonomy controller's own compliant stop and controlled handoff are not observable.

boundary_adjudication.decisive_blocker: Actual autonomous task pursuit, admissible-route exhaustion and the vehicle's own exit decision are not reported. A system failure causing immobility cannot alone establish the distinctive safe-exit governance mechanism.
boundary_adjudication.resolution_requirements: A verified vehicle controller/event-response sequence, passenger exit protocol, remote-assistance requirements or admissible alternative route state could establish a specific safe-exit failure or success. Do not infer task pursuit from immobility or safety from a no-injury outcome.

harm_impact_assessment.coverage_note: All twelve dimensions reviewed. At least one hundred vehicles stopped in live traffic, interrupting passenger transport and requiring police/company response. This supports retained bounded S3 operational disruption. Safe exit and no injury are affirmative findings, but traffic-related inability to leave safely was an actual bounded safety exposure. No permanent injury or medical treatment is inferred. Relational-role and heightened personal-protection recognition and exclusions independently tested.

dimensions.assessment_basis: Police confirm no injuries and safe eventual exit. Some passengers could not safely leave stopped vehicles because of surrounding heavy traffic and sought police assistance. This is actual bounded safety exposure without professional medical treatment, supporting S2 rather than a no-consequence S1 finding. No collision, injury or life-threatening outcome is inferred.
